morphology.pattern_note: 外来姓氏，整词作为独立单位记忆；词尾 -son 不是马来语后缀。正式拼写首字母大写。输入未提供音节、音标或爪夷文，保留 null；具体读音随姓名使用者而定。

senses.zh_definition: 莱文森：一种外来姓氏，具体所指人物须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Levinson, a surname whose bearer must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga asing yang ditulis Levinson; orang yang dirujuk ditentukan melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas（专有名词），本格式以 noun 标注。输入未提供 DBP 释义；这里是名称说明，不是 DBP 官方释义。status 按指定格式保留 official，不代表该姓氏已获 DBP 词条认证。不能仅凭此姓氏确定某位作者、理论提出者或个人身份。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila pastikan nama keluarga Levinson dieja dengan betul dalam senarai peserta.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请确保参与者名单中的 Levinson 姓氏拼写正确。
dual_scenarios.en: Please ensure that the surname Levinson is spelled correctly in the participant list.

messages.en: Their surname is Levinson, right? I just want to check the spelling.

messages.ms_spoken: Ya, betul. Aku dah semak nama tu dalam borang.

messages.en: Yes, that's right. I've already checked the name on the form.

etymology.historical_story: The Dictionary of American Family Names identifies Levinson as an Ashkenazic Jewish patronymic formed from the personal names Levin or Levy. A patronymic preserves an ancestral naming relationship rather than an ordinary descriptive meaning. When the surname appears in Malay writing, it remains a personal identifier; its historical background does not establish the identity or beliefs of any particular bearer. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/Levinson)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Levinson 当作通讯录里的完整姓氏记；看到大写 L，先想到人名，再根据上下文找具体人物。
